name: Student Volunteer at PAMF Mountain View and Sunnyvale Centers (Volunteer On Demand)
org: Sutter Health, Palo Alto Medical Foundation (PAMF)
city: Mountain View, CA (701 East El Camino Real) and Sunnyvale, CA (301 Old San Francisco Road)
what_you_do: You greet patients and work at the front desk. You help people find their way and push wheelchairs a little. You also stock magazines and help with lost and found.
who_can_apply: Age 16 and older. You are asked to make a six-month commitment.
duration: Six months, weekday 4-hour shifts (8 am to 12 pm or 12 pm to 4 pm)
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Both listings said Actively recruiting on 2026-10-16.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on either page. Questions? Email PAMFSOUTHBAYADMIN@sutterhealth.org.
notes: Read on the official Sutter Health listings on 2026-10-16. These are outpatient medical centers, not hospitals. Shifts are Monday to Friday only, so this fits summer or students with free weekday time. The Sunnyvale and Mountain View listings use the same text and the same contact. They do not state health screening, TB test or fees.
